verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a public Pulumi Cloud REST API, used by the CLI for state, history and stack tags, and a `pulumi api` command that can call any REST endpoint. It also documents the Automation API, which exposes the engine as an SDK to create, update, configure and destroy infrastructure programmatically, and a community user confirms coding infrastructure migrations with it. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe got 404 on all candidate paths), and evidence showing more than the one-line description of the REST API reference's depth and endpoint coverage.
